authorization: User requested the uncalibrated IMERG comparison to complete the original proposed study.
design: Paired forcing sensitivity on existing six calibration and four now-seen evaluation events; not fresh independent validation.
clock: Identical UTC windows and half-hour grid. Advance source rainfall start labels 30 minutes to interval ends.
identical_controls: Same basin methods, parameters, Q0, area, discharge observations, control windows and timestep. Only forcing band changes.
metrics: NSE, HMS modified KGE, trapezoidal total volume bias, HMS sampled-flow bias, peak error, signed peak timing, RMSE; exact observations and earliest tied peaks.
comparison: Report uncalibrated minus calibrated NSE/KGE and signed biases; compare absolute volume/peak/timing errors. Separate six-event and four-event arithmetic summaries, plus original three-group overlap sensitivity summary for the four events. No pooled volumes or pooled scores.
restrictions: No tuning, forcing scaling, event reselection, window changes, selecting a new final model, inference of independent precipitation accuracy or renewed holdout claims.
stopping: One new uncalibrated run per event, maximum ten. Stop on unexplained error or failed independent input/output reconciliation; no automatic retries. Known auxiliary .out WARNING10168 may be disclosed if numerical checks pass.
baseline_status: Original calibrated C072 baseline and prior calibration/validation decisions remain unchanged.
